items.text: Pittsburgh (off bye): WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) and DL Derrick Harmon (foot) eligible to come off IR, 'getting close' but no projection yet. No new injuries. Aaron Rodgers starts.

items.text: Cincinnati (early week, back from Madrid): IR - DE Cashius Howell (wrist). Monitor - LG Dylan Fairchild (pec/shoulder, hurt late Wk9; update Wednesday), S Kyle Dugger (quad, inactive 2 straight), CB DJ Turner II (heel). Joe Burrow starts.
